entries.title: Operate KIDULTS as one integrated program with three independent tracks
entries.decision: Track A creates snapshot candidates, Track B independently validates rankability, Track C renders released snapshots, and Production approval remains with the Program Owner.
entries.reason: Prevent isolated chat projects, duplicated assumptions and untraceable handoffs.

entries.title: Separate stable Core Vertical coverage from dynamic Featured selection
entries.decision: The eight Core Verticals remain the stable coverage structure. Featured Set, Hero, representative objects, market signals and research are dynamic and snapshot-specific.
entries.reason: Data can change and must drive Portal content without forcing structural redesign.

entries.title: Proof before procurement
entries.decision: Provider contact and spend are justified by measured gaps against the provider-independent baseline and independent rankability findings.
entries.reason: Avoid buying data before Right Data scope, stress readiness and measurable provider value are defined.
